title: Pluggable classification backends
text: Five backends ship package. Pass name configured constructor backend argument xplus(): Constructors expose learner hyperparameters parsnip-harmonized names, e.g. xplus_backend_ranger(trees = 1000, mtry = 4) xplus_backend_xgboost(trees = 200, learn_rate = 0.05). ranger, mgcv, xgboost, lightgbm Suggests, install use backends. sixth path wraps parsnip model spec directly: xplus_backend_parsnip() flips spec’s mode per fit — classification binary iterative targets, regression fractional final ones — maps case weights hardhat weight vectors, injects engine seeds xplus(seed = ...) stays reproducible, reuses --bag scores engine stores . Specs whose model lacks regression mode fail clear message final stage. nonlinear boundary elastic-net logistic fit collapses toward chance forest tracks radial structure; linear boundaries ranking reverses, exactly learner now choice rather constant.
code: library(parsnip) backend <- rand_forest(trees = 500) |>   set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>   xplus_backend_parsnip() fit <- xplus(x, y, backend = backend) library(xplus) #> Package 'xplus' version 1.0.2.9000 #> Type 'citation("xplus")' for citing this R package in publications. sim <- simulate_pu_data(n = 400, p = 8, boundary = "nonlinear",                         prevalence = 0.4, label_propensity = 0.5, seed = 11) unl <- sim$y == 0  fit_glmnet <- xplus(sim$x, sim$y, backend = "glmnet", max_iter = 30, seed = 3) fit_ranger <- xplus(sim$x, sim$y, backend = xplus_backend_ranger(trees = 300),                     max_iter = 30, seed = 3)  data.frame(   backend = c("glmnet", "ranger"),   auc_unlabeled = c(auc(sim$z[unl], as.numeric(predict(fit_glmnet))[unl]),                     auc(sim$z[unl], as.numeric(predict(fit_ranger))[unl])),   cutoff = c(fit_glmnet$cutoff, fit_ranger$cutoff),   n_iter = c(fit_glmnet$n_iter, fit_ranger$n_iter) ) #>   backend auc_unlabeled   cutoff n_iter #> 1  glmnet     0.5000000 0.581250     12 #> 2  ranger     0.8932671 0.140136      9

title: Pluggable classification backends
text: xplus_backend() defines minimal estimator interface — fit weighted (x, y) data, predict probabilities — shared caret modelInfo entries, sklearn fit/predict_proba estimators, mlr3 Learners:

title: Pluggable classification backends
text: xplus_grid() fits every candidate shared bootstrap seeds ranks pu_score() — positive-vs-unlabeled AUC honest stored predictions, orders learners consistently SCAR labeling: lacsSample dataset (600 curated PU text documents reduced 300-term TF-IDF matrix, 153 positives vs 447 unlabeled) PU ranking recovers expected text-model ordering — glmnet 0.999 > ranger 0.966 > lightgbm 0.958 > xgboost 0.938 — ranks xgboost hyperparameter settings correctly (300 trees learn_rate 0.05 beat smaller, faster settings). Linear learners win sparse text; forests win curved boundaries. leaderboard makes choice empirical one. pattern holds open binary datasets PU-ified pu_mask() — UCI spambase (ranger 0.852 ≈ glmnet 0.845 > xgboost 0.807) mushroom (xgboost 0.843 > lightgbm 0.836 > glmnet 0.818), winner changes feature geometry, every ranking produced without ever reading hidden negatives.

title: Positive and Unlabeled Learning from Unbalanced Cases and Sparse Structures
text: paper’s algorithm, authors’ reference implementation, package’s extensions distinct. reference implementation already uses replacement sampling followed deduplication, sampling budgets learning-rate smoothing; new inventions package. Sample unlabeled cases replacement fit penalized binomial models alongside known positives. new default sampling = "bootstrap" preserves draw multiplicities case weights unique rows. identity assigned one CV fold, preventing copies one observation leaking training validation. sampling = "unique" opts legacy deduplication; restore every 0.1.x default. sample_use_time limits number completed inclusion rounds per unlabeled identity, number bootstrap draws. identity appearing several times one round spends one budget unit. sampling_counts records inclusion rounds; draw_counts records multiplicities. cv_measure = "deviance" default iterative final fits. "auc" opt-explicitly falls back deviance small samples (fewer 10 observations per fold average), warning effective iterative measures history. Requested folds reduced available class counts. Sampled iterative labels must support least three unique observations per class; 20 retries precede stop_reason = "degenerate_labels". Anchor predictions positive-reference qq quantile, normalize residuals, apply sigmoid. sigmoid_scale = 10 now independently configurable; public alpha remains glmnet’s elastic-net mixture sigmoid scale paper. learning_rate = 1 retains "current" path, updating sampled unlabeled cases Bernoulli training labels. 0 < learning_rate < 1 still selects package’s "continuous_enhancement" path: smooths probabilities globally hard-thresholds unlabeled iterative training labels. paths use soft targets final fit. Stability uses 1 - mean(abs(mapped_score - previous_pseudo_label)) across unlabeled cases learning-rate damping. Defaults min_iter = 5, stability_window = 5, min_coverage = 0.9 require least five iterations, full window five consecutive scores strictly convergence_threshold, 90% inclusion coverage. small learning rate alone manufacture convergence. Inspect stop_reason, n_iter, history, sampling counts. "label_stability" denotes stated heuristic; "budget_exhausted", "max_iter" "degenerate_labels" describe different stopping conditions, equivalent successes.

Random seed reproducibility, applied via set.seed(). Default NULL (seed). sigmoid_scale, degenerate_threshold Positive sigmoid scale nonnegative residual-clamping tolerance. min_iter, stability_window Minimum iterations consecutive stable iterations required declaring convergence. xplus retains two iterative paths, distinct paper's pseudocode: "current" (learning_rate = 1) uses sampled Bernoulli labels, "continuous_enhancement" (learning_rate < 1) smooths probabilities updates unlabeled hard labels. use soft final fitting targets. Stability compares undamped mapped scores current pseudo-labels across unlabeled cases requires full window sampling coverage. min_coverage Minimum fraction unlabeled cases sampled convergence, [0, 1]. Bootstrap multiplicities represented case weights, keeping duplicate copies together CV. sampling = "unique" retains legacy deduplication. Final-fit fallback based effective class mass, thresholded labels, recorded actual fitting targets iteration history. sampling, cv_measure Sampling convention ("bootstrap" "unique") CV criterion ("deviance" "auc"); deviance default fitting stages. backend Learner iterative final fits: one "glmnet", "ranger", "gam", "xgboost", "lightgbm", xplus_backend() object custom backends. alpha cv_measure configure "glmnet" backend.

text: name Nonempty character scalar identifying backend. fit Function signature fit(x, y, foldid, weights) returning fitted model object. x finite numeric feature matrix, y numeric target [0, 1] (binary iterations, possibly fractional final fit), foldid stratified cross-validation fold assignment, weights nonnegative case weights encoding bootstrap multiplicities. report cross-validation measure iteration history, attach attr(model, "xplus_cv_measure") "deviance" "auc"; otherwise "none" recorded. predict Function signature predict(model, newx) returning finite probabilities [0, 1], one per row newx. importance Optional function signature importance(model) returning named numeric vector feature scores, NULL. label Human-readable backend label; defaults name. uses_cv Logical scalar; whether fit performs internal cross-validation whose measure recorded iteration history. parameters Optional data frame declaring tunable hyperparameters following caret modelInfo convention (columns parameter, class, label); informational , enables future tuning AutoML adapters without changing backend contract. fit_predict Optional function signature fit_predict(model, x) returning honest probabilities rows passed fit, order — --bag held--fold estimates rather -sample memorization. xplus() uses final fit cutoff calibration stored training predictions; non-finite entries fall back predict rows. NULL, predict reused training rows, appropriate learners memorize per-observation targets. Iterative pseudo-label fits always use predict, keeps self-training dynamics uniform across backends. supports_fractional Logical scalar; whether fit handles fractional targets [0, 1] (final pseudo-label fit). FALSE, xplus() fails clear error final targets non-binary instead surfacing engine-specific error deep learner. supports_weights Logical scalar; whether fit honors case weights.
